normal.text: Mr. Zero's FZGX drip is truly insane. I continue to be obsessed with this character who started as a nameless NPC in the SNES instruction booklet, like, DAMN 12 year later he has a legit media job in FZGX? GOOD FOR HIM!!!!

normal.name: Gatzdaze
normal.text: This is a reminder that Square made an RPG based on Tom Sawyer back in 1989 on the NES. I believe classic literature is a potential goldmine for gaming ideas. Looking forward Jane Autin’s Pride and Prejudice RPG in the near future

normal.name: World Champ 🔜 paxu
normal.text: Have people been digging control resonant? I’ve been real excited to play it but gotta finish hellraiser first, surprised I haven’t seen much since its release but I’m not too tapped into video game discourse.

normal.name: わはは
normal.text: But this *is* the franchise that gave us "oh yeah you have to effectively kill an entire island of people to finish the game" and was my first "oh fuck, video games can do stories like *that*?" realization, so it's just par for the course, I guess. #OoT

normal.name: GamerBait
normal.text: Happy Friday the 13th. Who else remembers LJN's 1989 NES game, developed by Atlus, where Jason inexplicably wore a purple and turquoise jumpsuit? Did anyone actually beat it? #RetroGaming

heated.text: As much as the current landscape in regards to AI sucks, I am really happy about a lot of my favorite games which were stuck on old consoles with terrible performance being ported to PC now 🥹 Playing Gravity Rush 2 and Bloodborne with really good performance is a dream come true.
